ideas.pitch: A high-performance order matching engine written strictly in C++20 focusing on cache locality, low-latency data structures, and deterministic execution.
ideas.problem_statement: Build your own order-matching engine in a single file (engine.cpp) using the C++20 standard library to process limit, market, cancel, FOK, IOC orders, and self-trade prevention with minimal latency.
ideas.title: Cache-Optimized C++20 Order Matching Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact core systems-programming challenge set by the organizers with a focus on latency benchmarking, which directly dictates the live leaderboard ranking.

ideas.pitch: An auxiliary compliance module designed for high-frequency trading engines to instantly detect and prevent self-trades without locking order books.
ideas.problem_statement: Implement self-trade prevention rules alongside limit and market order matching inside a single-file C++20 engine harness.
ideas.title: Deterministic Self-Trade Prevention Module
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses edge-case correctness requirements that evaluation harnesses test heavily before moving to pure speed benchmarks.

ideas.pitch: A custom allocator-free limit order book data structure using contiguous memory vectors to eliminate dynamic allocation overhead during live event streaming.
ideas.problem_statement: Match reference matching engine behavior on hidden order streams efficiently while minimizing latency on the live leaderboard.
ideas.title: Zero-Allocation Limit Order Book
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies genuine low-latency systems engineering techniques like avoiding heap allocations in the hot path, satisfying the judges' focus on cache optimization and C++20 proficiency.

ideas.pitch: Optimized conditional order execution paths for Fill-Or-Kill (FOK) and Immediate-Or-Cancel (IOC) orders inside a high-throughput matching loop.
ideas.problem_statement: An evaluation harness streams order events into your engine including fill-or-kill and IOC orders that require rapid conditional parsing.
ideas.title: IOC and FOK Specialized Execution Handler
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on correctness for complex order types, ensuring high scores on visible unit tests and hidden test streams before latency optimization.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight diagnostic utility to capture, record, and replay malformed or high-frequency order streams against the engine for rapid regression testing.
ideas.problem_statement: Pass the visible unit tests and match the reference matching engine on a hidden order stream under strict time constraints.
ideas.title: Low-Latency Event Stream Replay Debugger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides exceptional developer tooling polish during a intense hands-on systems programming session, allowing rapid iteration speed against the evaluation harness.
